- [[Arc Welder|Arc Welder]] : 6 x Aluminium Plate, 4 x Copper Plate, 4 x [[gv:steel_scaffold|Steel Scaffold]].

Used to make :
[[gv:missile_buster|Bunker Buster]], [[gv:missile_cluster|Cluster Missile]], [[gv:missile_decoy|Decoy Missile]], [[gv:missile_generic|High Explosive Missile]], [[gv:missile_incendiary|Incendiary Missile]].
